newRelationTypes.name: attributed-to

newRelationTypes.definition: Indicates that a threat actor utilizes a specific malware family or malicious component in operations.

newRelationTypes.name: uses-tool
newRelationTypes.definition: Indicates that an actor deploys or executes a legitimate utility or software tool during an attack.
